en: Hello. I am a health worker from the clinic.
sw: Habari. Mimi ni mhudumu wa afya kutoka kliniki.

en: This device helps us understand each other.
May I ask you some questions about your health?
sw: Naweza kukuuliza maswali kuhusu afya yako?

en: What you tell me stays private.
You can ask me to stop at any time.
How many days have you been sick?
Are you allergic to any medicine?
Is the child eating and drinking?
Has the child had all the vaccinations?
You need to see a clinician today.
sw: Unahitaji kumwona mhudumu wa afya leo.

en: Come back if you feel worse.
sw: Rudi kama hali yako itakuwa mbaya zaidi.

en: Keep this card and bring it next time.
sw: Hifadhi kadi hii na uje nayo wakati ujao.
